This awesome buildable toy playset is part of a series of LEGO Star Wars mechs, which also includes the 75368 Darth Vader Mech and 75370 Stormtrooper Mech sets (sold separately).

productName: Stormtrooper Mech
description:
Give young kids an exciting introduction to the brick-built LEGO® Star Wars™ universe with this Stormtrooper Mech (75370) for play and display. The posable mech suit has an opening cockpit for the Stormtrooper LEGO minifigure, a clip for his blaster and gripping hands to hold the large stud-shooting blaster. LEGO Builder
An awesome anytime gift for kids aged 6 and up, this LEGO Star Wars mech is designed to be easy to build so the action play starts fast. Enhance their creative experience with the LEGO Builder app, which features intuitive building instructions with 3D zoom and rotate viewing tools and allows them to track their progress and save sets. Collectible LEGO Star Wars building toy
This mech model building kit is part of a series of LEGO Star Wars mechs, which also includes the 75368 Darth Vader Mech and 75369 Boba Fett Mech sets (sold separately).

productName: 5-Minute LEGO Builds
description: Kids will be thrilled to discover what they can create with this fantastic 5-Minute LEGO® Builds book. They will be spoilt for choice with over 100 fast ideas, including exclusive mini models, puzzles, games and challenges. There is also a basic kit of 50 LEGO bricks to get the fun started right away. This interactive, 96-page, hardcover book will help kids develop their creative sides and fuel their imaginations as they follow the step-by-step building instructions.

productName: Exotic Pink Parrot
description:
Little builders and passionate animal fans aged 7+ can travel deep into the rainforest for action-packed stories with this LEGO® Creator 3in1 Exotic Pink Parrot (31144) building set. It features a vivid pink and blue parrot that can fully rotate its body while sitting on a tree branch and move its wings and tail. 3in1 toys kick-start creative fun
Kids can build 3 different exotic animal toys with this fantastic LEGO 3in1 set. They can build a brightly colored parrot sitting on a tree branch, rebuild it into a playful fish swimming at the bottom of the sea or make a cheeky frog that can move its legs. A fun digital experience for LEGO fans
Download the LEGO Builder app and step into a new world of building fun where kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress.

productName: 100 Ways to Rebuild the World
description: Encourage children to be courageous, curious, caring and optimistic with LEGO® 100 Ways to Rebuild the World. This illustrated book features 100 fun, practical ideas for kids to make life better and more colorful, brick by brick. Plant bee-friendly flowers and build LEGO bees to spread the message; make a LEGO thank-you card for a neighbor; or create a LEGO emoji to make a friend smile… How will your youngster rebuild the world? The choice is theirs!

productName: LEGO Nutcracker
description: Celebrate the holiday season with the LEGO® Nutcracker (40640) building set. This LEGO interpretation of the iconic Nutcracker figure can be built with a male or female face and comes with movable arms and an opening mouth. A fun gift idea and an enjoyable build for kids, friends and families, this festive figure will bring a seasonal charm to any home or workplace.

productName: Harry Potter & Cho Chang
description: Fans can relive epic Quidditch™ games as they build these LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Harry Potter™ & Cho Chang (40616) figures. With authentic details such as the Gryffindor™ and Ravenclaw™ house Quidditch uniforms, plus Golden Snitch™ and broomstick accessory elements, the buildable duo make a magical anytime LEGO gift for kids aged 10 and up and any Harry Potter collector.

productName: Draco Malfoy & Cedric Diggory
description: Spark memories of dramatic Quidditch™ games for Harry Potter™ fans with these LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Draco Malfoy™ & Cedric Diggory (40617) figures. The brick-built characters are dressed in the Slytherin™ and Hufflepuff™ house uniforms they wear for Quidditch games. An inspirational LEGO gift for kids aged 10 and up, the set includes a house cup and 2 broomstick accessory elements to complete a spellbinding display.

productName: Miles "Tails" Prower
description: Sweet-natured Tails is a favorite character from the Sonic the Hedgehog™ universe. Now fans of the two-tailed fox can celebrate Tails’ genius and loyalty with this LEGO® BrickHeadz™ Miles "Tails" Prower (40628) set. The building kit includes a baseplate so kids aged 10 and up can create a fun display piece for their desks or gaming stations.

productName: Icons of Play
description: Inspire any soccer fan aged 12 and up with this LEGO® Icons of Play (40634) buildable toy set, featuring half a soccer field with a goal and VAR station, stands with a scoreboard, a ceremonial stage and more. Some of the 15 minifigures represent famous soccer players like crafty and creative Megan Rapinoe, the multi-talented Yūki Nagasato, world-class striker Sam Kerr and global superstar Asisat Oshoala. A fun gift idea for soccer lovers to build, play with and display.

productName: Dream Village
description: Let kids aged 7+ explore a magical setting from the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ TV show with this exciting Dream Village (40657) building toy set. A fantastical location frequently visited by the heroes during their sleep, the village is home to an array of dream creatures and charming businesses such as the magic shop, bakery and blacksmith’s workshop. Kids can choose to play out a shopping scene or rearrange the included modules to create a defense tower to prepare for Grimspawn attacks!

productName: Jurassic World Activity Landscape Box
description: Inspire children to create their own exciting adventure stories with the LEGO® Jurassic World Activity Landscape Box. It includes an activity book, a dinosaur trivia book and a 3D pop-up play scene, plus LEGO minifigures of dinosaur behavior expert Owen Grady and poacher Rainn Delacourt with accessories to play out epic showdowns. This boxful of fun makes a super gift for young Jurassic World fans and any kid who loves LEGO Jurassic World playsets.

productName: Build and Stick: NINJAGO Dragons
description: Ninja fans will be thrilled to build, customize and play out action with the 3 exclusive models that accompany this LEGO® Build and Stick: NINJAGO® Dragons activity book. There are 49 LEGO bricks for kids to build and rebuild into an Elemental Dragon, a Dragon Mech or an Evil Dragon, plus over 270 durable stickers for them to use to personalize their creations. The 48-page book features instructions, games, puzzles and coloring pages, letting kids enjoy countless hours of ninja action.

productName: 5-Minute Harry Potter Builds
description: Spark kids’ imaginations with LEGO® Harry Potter™ 5-Minute Harry Potter Builds. This magical 96-page book features over 100 mini-model building ideas and challenges. Each activity is designed to take no longer than 5 minutes, and kids can undertake them solo or share the fun with friends and family. With 65 LEGO bricks included to help children build, the book makes a fantastic gift for any youngster who is fascinated by the Wizarding World and LEGO Harry Potter playsets.

productName: Peter Pan & Wendy's Flight over London
description:
Sky-high adventures await Disney fans aged 10+ with this LEGO® ǀ Disney Peter Pan & Wendy’s Flight over London (43232) set. The detailed diorama depicts the iconic flying scene from the classic film, featuring London’s Big Ben with 3 glow-in-the-dark clockfaces, a cloud with stars and a glow-in-the-dark moon, a river with bridges and a doghouse. Also included are 3 LEGO ǀ Disney minifigures, a LEGO dog figure and a 100th Anniversary plaque. As they create, kids can enjoy an easy, intuitive building adventure with the LEGO Builder app, zoom in and rotate models in 3D, and track their progress. Iconic characters
Based on the classic Disney film Peter Pan, this set is made for play and display. It can inspire imaginative adventures and then take pride of place on a shelf once play is done. The set has 3 LEGO ǀ Disney minifigures: Disney’s Peter Pan, Wendy and Tinker Bell, plus a Nana LEGO dog figure, and can be a fun gift for adult fans or older kids who want to join the hottest trend.

productName: The Art of the Minifigure
description: LEGO® The Art of the Minifigure celebrates the history, design and global impact of the beloved LEGO minifigure over the course of the past 4 decades. This 144-page, richly illustrated book takes LEGO fans behind the scenes and shows how a minifigure evolves from initial sketches to the final product. There are also fascinating essays and interviews, beautiful photography, infographics and exclusive visuals from the archives on one of the most collectible toys in the world.

productName: Batmobile: Batman vs. The Joker Chase
description:
LEGO® DC Batmobile™: Batman™ vs. The Joker™ Chase (76224) puts Super Hero action with the iconic 1989 Batmobile into the hands of kids aged 8 and up. Batman adventures on wheels
This Batmobile playset brings all the drama and excitement of the classic 1989 movie to life. A lift-off roof provides access to the vehicle’s cockpit, with room for a minifigure in the driving seat. When kids turn a control on the side of the car, 2 built-in blasters rise into position. A flame element attached to the tailpipe revolves as the Batmobile moves, and a flip-open trunk provides storage space for the included Batarang™, harpoon spike and handcuffs. There are 2 minifigures – Batman and The Joker – plus accessories including a helmet and cape. For added digital fun, builders can zoom in, rotate models in 3D and track their progress using the fun, intuitive LEGO Builder app.

productName: Stop The Fire!
description: Kids ages 5+ can dive into hours of adventure with “LEGO® City: Stop the Fire!” This 32-page activity book is packed funny comic strips, exciting stories, fun activities, and challenging puzzles for them to enjoy. A super gift idea for fans of the LEGO City Adventures TV series, it also includes a minifigure of fire chief Freya McCloud and a buildable fire-fighting robot for action-packed role play.

productName: Go Extreme!
description: Get ready for a wild ride with Go Extreme! Based on the animated LEGO® City Adventures TV series, this 32-page activity book lets children explore the extreme sports of LEGO City with the included Dynamo Doug minifigure. Go Extreme! takes kids on an imaginative adventure where they skateboard through mazes, enjoy hilarious comic strip stories and much more. The book makes a super gift for young fans of LEGO building sets.

productName: Secret Coding Fun!
description: There’s endless imaginative fun to be enjoyed with the LEGO® DOTS: Secret Coding Fun! book. This 64-page, hardcover book includes all the instructions, inspiration and accessories kids need to create secret-message bracelets: 2 bangles, 36 DOTS tiles (with glow-in-the-dark, glitter and printed options), over 255 stickers, secret message note cards and 50-plus ideas for coding messages.

productName: Race Cars
description: LEGO® Race Cars will thrill and fascinate both car lovers and LEGO fans. The 64-page hardcover book is packed with incredible facts about some of the coolest, fastest and strangest cars to have ever been driven. For instance, did you know that there’s a car that runs on coffee? The book also comes with a buildable, high-quality 3-foot (36 in.) racetrack and 124 elements for kids to build and customize 10 cars. Once built, they can pit the cars against each other in exciting, action-packed races.

productName: How to Build LEGO Dinosaurs
description: Feed a child’s passion for dinosaurs and help them on their journey to become a better builder with How to Build LEGO® Dinosaurs. This 96-page, illustrated book features 30 LEGO dinosaurs, from an Ankylosaurus to a T. rex, and shows kids the essential building steps to recreate them with their own LEGO bricks. The models get more challenging through the book, developing your youngster’s confidence until they can build any dinosaur and even create their own imaginary prehistoric creatures.

productName: Heavy-Duty Bulldozer
description: Give young vehicle fans a treat with the LEGO® Technic™ Heavy-Duty Bulldozer (42163) set for kids aged 7+ who love construction toys. Inspired by real bulldozers, the yellow color scheme captures the imaginations of new Technic builders, encouraging boys and girls to develop new building skills. Authentic details include the tracks and the blade, which kids can lift and lower using the element on top of the bulldozer. This set makes a great gift idea for kids who love vehicles.  LEGO Technic construction sets feature realistic details that introduce young LEGO builders to engineering in an approachable way. Give kids a fun building adventure with the LEGO Builder app, which lets them zoom in and rotate models in 3D and track their progress.

productName: Green Race Car
description: The LEGO® City Green Race Car (60399) opens the door to a world of creative play for kids aged 4+. Prepare to cheer on your little racer and embrace the magic of playtime together with this LEGO racing car toy, featuring sporty tires and a cool rear spoiler. This set also includes photographer and racing driver minifigures, plus a winner’s trophy for imaginative storytelling.  This easy-build toy car playset makes a cool gift for kids aged 4+. It comes with a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City playsets put kids at the heart of the action with realistic vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters for imaginative play without limits. Combine this vehicle toy with other sets (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for an open-ended world of play possibilities.

productName: Go-Karts and Race Drivers
description: Fans of race car toys can enjoy endless action with this LEGO® City Go-Karts and Race Drivers (60400) toy vehicle playset for kids aged 5 and up. Little racers can choose between 2 driver minifigures before playing out exciting competitions with the orange and turquoise mini go-karts.This toy go-kart racing set makes a fun gift for kids and includes an easy-to-follow printed building guide, with digital instructions available in the LEGO Builder app. Using this intuitive building companion, kids can zoom in and rotate sets in 3D to visualize models from all angles as they build. The app also lets them track their progress and explore and save virtual playsets.Children grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines and with LEGO City building sets they explore them up close with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended, imaginative play without limits.

productName: Construction Steamroller
description: Introducing the coolest toy steamroller in town! With its chunky tires and shiny rolling drum, the LEGO® City Construction Steamroller (60401) is perfect for fans of toy trucks and construction vehicles. Just like the real thing, it has a toy warning beacon and a cockpit for the driver minifigure. This fun toy will inspire creativity and imagination in children aged 5+ and can be combined with similar toys (sold separately) from the LEGO City range.  This toy steamroller isn’t just fun to play with. Kids also get a rewarding building experience with an easy-to-follow printed building guide, plus digital instructions in the LEGO Builder app. This intuitive building companion lets kids zoom in, rotate sets in 3D and visualize models from all angles as they build.  Kids grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines, and with LEGO City Great Vehicles building sets they get to explore them up close with realistic models and fun characters that inspire imaginative play without limits.

productName: Blue Monster Truck
description: Looking for an engaging toy playset for kids aged 5+? The LEGO® City Blue Monster Truck (60402) is a great choice. This rugged off-road toy vehicle boasts huge rubber tires and a sturdy design that can handle action-packed play. Your child will have a blast zooming around and taking on daring jumps with an awesome toy that includes a driver minifigure for imaginative role play.  This toy monster truck isn’t just great to play with. Kids can enjoy a fun building experience with both a pictorial building guide and step-by-step digital instructions in the LEGO Builder app. With this intuitive building companion, kids can visualize models in 3D as they build, track the building process and explore and save virtual playsets.  Your City, No Limits! In LEGO City, kids create their own imaginative adventures whether they're soaring through the skies, racing around tracks, chasing crooks or fighting fires. Combine this set with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for even more fun.

productName: Emergency Ambulance and Snowboarder
description: Join your little builder for quality playtime with the LEGO® City Emergency Ambulance and Snowboarder (60403) playset, featuring a toy ambulance with chunky tires for off-road rescues. This fun set also includes a mini scene depicting a snow-covered skate park, plus snowboarder and paramedic minifigures for imaginative storytelling.  This easy-build rescue vehicle toy playset comes with a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  Your City, No Limits! LEGO City sets feature cool vehicles, realistic structures and fun characters that inspire open-ended imaginative play based on real-life events. Combine this emergency vehicle playset with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City range for a whole world of play possibilities.

productName: Burger Truck
description: This LEGO® City Burger Truck (60404) toy playset for ages 5 and up is a treat for young imaginations. Topped with a giant burger, the mobile fast-food joint can be detached from the truck and comes with a detailed food prep area, condiments and a service hatch that opens to display a flame-grilled burger sign. This set also includes a vendor minifigure and a customer minifigure with a cochlear implant.  You’ll find building instructions for the LEGO City Burger Truck toy in the box. Or you visit the LEGO Builder app where kids can explore and save sets, track their own building progress, and zoom and rotate to view models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City building sets put kids at the heart of the action with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended imaginative play without limits. The sets make fun gifts and can be combined (other sets sold separately) for an open-ended world of play possibilities.

productName: Emergency Rescue Helicopter
description: Treat your everyday hero with the LEGO® City Emergency Rescue Helicopter (60405) playset. Designed for ages 6 and up, this set features a toy helicopter with a cool cockpit, spinnable rotors, an opening cargo bay and a working winch. Just add the hiker, pilot and rescuer minifigures, toy rescue flare and a sprinkle of imagination for hours of action-packed play.  Take your youngster on an exciting toy building adventure with the LEGO Builder app. Here they can explore and save sets, track their own building progress, and zoom and rotate to view models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City playsets come with realistic toy vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters for imaginative play without limits. Combine this fun set with others (sold separately) from the LEGO City Great Vehicles range for even bigger adventures.

productName: Race Car and Car Carrier Truck
description: Rev up the excitement with this LEGO® City Race Car and Car Carrier Truck (60406) playset, a perfect gift to fuel kids’ love for toy cars and trucks. Designed for ages 6 and up, this set features a race truck with a functional loading ramp and a cool race car with lowered suspension and flared fenders. The set also includes race driver and truck driver minifigures for role-playing fun stories and adventures.  This Race Car and Car Carrier Truck playset includes an easy-to-follow printed building guide and step-by-step 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app. Here kids can zoom and rotate to visualize models from all angles as they build.  Kids grow up surrounded by amazing vehicles and machines, and with LEGO City Great Vehicles building sets they get to explore them up close, with realistic models and fun characters that inspire open-ended, imaginative play.

productName: Spaceship and Asteroid Discovery
description: Join your little astronaut for out-of-this-world adventures with this 4+ LEGO® City Spaceship and Asteroid Discovery (60429) playset, featuring a toy spaceship and 2 asteroid surface scenes depicting a laboratory and an excavation area with a crane. Just add the 2 space-crew minifigures, alien figure and crystal-rich meteorite for imaginative play and storytelling.  This easy-build space toy makes a fun gift for kids who love pretend play. It includes a LEGO Starter Brick element, a pictorial guide and 3D instructions in the LEGO Builder app – a digital building companion with intuitive tools that enable kids to zoom in and rotate and visualize models from all angles as they build.  LEGO City space-themed toys make a great gift for any occasion, with realistic vehicles, detailed structures and inspiring characters that merge fantasy and reality for imaginative play without limits. Kids can add this set to others (sold separately) in the LEGO City space range for more epic space action.

productName: Animal Train
description: Know a youngster who loves creative play and nature toys? Introduce toddlers aged 18 months and up to color-matching play with the LEGO® DUPLO® My First Animal Train (10412) set.  This preschool kids’ learning toy comes with 4 cute, buildable animals toys – a rooster, horse, lamb and cow – that transport toddlers on a journey of fun role play. Toddlers learn problem-solving skills as they follow the cards to construct the animals then match them to the colored train toy carriages. This vehicle toy also includes 2 extra bricks to let kids express their creativity as they build and rebuild the animals into toy figures of their own invention. Playful features, such as the rooster’s flexible neck and the toy train carriages that connect help hone a toddler’s motor skills.  LEGO DUPLO animal toys for toddlers put open-ended fun, self-expression and joyful exploration into young children’s hands while parents share their child’s precious developmental milestones.

productName: Caring for Bees & Beehives
description: Bring a buzz to playtimes with the LEGO® DUPLO® Caring for Bees & Beehives (10419) kids’ learning toy for ages 2 and up. This nature toy helps toddlers learn how to care for animals and nature and live sustainably.  This hands-on nature toy for kids comes with 2 cute bee figures, a beehive with a honeycomb brick, flower elements and a drivable truck. It teaches preschoolers that when they care for plants, bees get the food they need to make the honey we love to eat.  Toddlers practice fine motor skills as they build the toy flower stems to make them grow. They’ll have hours of role-play fun as they imagine the toy bees feeding on the nectar then returning to the beehive to make honey. This set also comes with 2 LEGO DUPLO figures – preschoolers help them to collect the honey, load it onto the toy truck and drive it to the market.  LEGO DUPLO development toy gifts let preschool kids share fun learning moments with their parents and caregivers.

productName: Alphabet Truck
description: Drive toddler’s letter-learning with the LEGO® DUPLO® Town Alphabet Truck (10421) construction toy for preschool kids.  This creative ABC toy delivers lots of playful learning. As toddlers connect the trailer with the toy truck and help the 2 LEGO DUPLO figures load and unload the bricks, they begin to recognize letters, learn colors, improve their language and hone fine motor skills.  Imaginative accessories include a LEGO DUPLO ABC book toy element and a stereo element to encourage fun ABC sing-alongs with parents and toddlers. This educational toy encourages toddlers to invent creative stories as they climb into their toy truck cab and head off for a new adventure!  Get toddlers off to great start with LEGO DUPLO construction toys, which put open-ended play, self-expression and learning into toddlers’ hands.

productName: Baby Dinosaur Rescue Center
description: Young fans aged 4+ can care for and play with dinosaur babies while learning to build with this LEGO® Jurassic World Baby Dinosaur Rescue Center (76963) set. It includes an off-road vehicle and research area with a cave wall, both with Starter Brick elements, plus a feeding station. 2 minifigures, baby Ankylosaurus, Triceratops and Velociraptor figures, and small Velociraptor and adult Pteranodon kids’ dinosaur toy figures get play started fast.  Picture instructions are included with this LEGO dinosaur toy for kids who are just learning to read. For added digital fun, the LEGO Builder app has intuitive zoom and rotate tools that help boys and girls see their model as they build.  LEGO Jurassic World 4+ sets introduce young kids to their favorite movie and TV characters and make a fun dinosaur LEGO set gift. They come with specially designed Starter Bricks, so even first-time builders can create vehicles, buildings and more with just a bit of help from an older sibling or adult.

productName: Flatbed Truck with Helicopter
description: Fast-paced adventures await boys and girls aged 7 and up with the LEGO® Creator Flatbed Truck with Helicopter (31146) playset. They can use the 3in1 set’s 270 pieces to build a cool transporter truck toy with moving wheels that can carry a LEGO helicopter with moving rotor blades on its trailer.  Kids can build 3 different vehicle toy sets containing 2 separate vehicles with this LEGO Creator 3in1 toy. They have the chance to build the Flatbed Truck with Helicopter, rebuild it into a propeller plane toy and fuel truck with moving wheels, make a hot rod and SUV toy car set for races, or use the bricks to create their own vehicles.  LEGO Creator 3in1 toys make great gifts for kids with 3 different models to create in every box. Kids will be excited to build, rebuild and build again. 3in1 sets keep them happy for countless hours and offer a range of models that appeal to their biggest passions, including superfast vehicles, amazing animals and detailed city scenes.

productName: Space Astronaut
description: LEGO® fans aged 9+ can blast into space to explore new planets by recreating space adventures with this LEGO Creator Space Astronaut (31152) building toy. The astronaut figure includes a detachable jet propulsion backpack, posable legs, feet, arms and fingers and a golden opening visor with a seat inside for a minifigure (not included).  Boys and girls can build 3 different space playsets: a posable space astronaut, a futuristic space dog with posable legs and tail, or a space viper jet with a se at for a minifigure (not included) to pilot it. All 3 models make great space-themed creative gifts and come with stands for display.  LEGO Creator 3in1 toys make great gifts for kids with 3 different models to create in every box. Kids will be excited to build, rebuild and build again. 3in1 sets keep them happy for countless hours and offer a range of models that appeal to their biggest passions, including superfast vehicles, amazing animals and detailed city scenes.

productName: Mobile Bakery Food Cart
description: Inspire creative play with the LEGO® Friends Mobile Bakery Food Cart (42606) playset for girls, boys and kids aged 6+. Kids who love role play can act out the story as Aliya visits the toy bakery cart with her pup Aira. The set includes 2 mini-dolls, a dog, a cart, a bakery mascot and accessories.  The accessories in this food playset for kids lets little ones create their own stories as they help Jules serve customers from the small toy vehicle. Accessories include a croissant, 2 macarons, cookies, a cookie container, coffee machine, coffee cup, hot chocolate and a cup of tea, plus a coin and a book for Aliya and a bone for Aira.  Discover more gift ideas for kids who love cooking toys in the LEGO Friends universe, where there are lots of opportunities for storytelling as kids act out real-life adventures. This set comes with the LEGO Builder app for an easy and intuitive building adventure. Here kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Tiny Accessories Store
description: Give creative kids a treat with this LEGO® Friends Tiny Accessories Store (42608) building toy for girls, boys and kids aged 6 plus. Kids who love toy beauty shops will enjoy helping Paisley and Candi shop for a new fanny pack and hair accessories. Kids can act out the story as the characters use the mirror to check out their new look, then pay using their smartphones at the self-serve checkout. This playset makes a fun gift for 6-year-old and up girls, boys and kids. The set comes with LEGO Friends Paisley and Candi mini-dolls so play can start right away. Fun accessories include 2 fanny packs for the characters to wear. Discover a range of role-play toys for kids in the LEGO Friends universe, where young builders can enjoy creative play and act out real-life adventures. This small LEGO set comes with the LEGO Builder app for an easy and intuitive building adventure. Here kids can zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Heartlake City Hospital
description: Kids who enjoy medical play and doctor role play have lots to explore in this LEGO® Friends Heartlake City Hospital (42621) playset. This toy hospital set makes a role-play gift for girls, boys and kids aged 7 plus. It features different areas and wards reflecting the areas found in a real hospital, including an examination room, maternity unit, X-ray room and employee break room.  There are lots of stories to discover as Autumn arrives to have a new prosthetic arm fitted. Kids will love taking visitors for a ride in the working elevator to meet the newborn babies in the maternity ward. Then they can create more stories in the examination room and employee break room. Fun accessories include a toy X-ray scanner, medical equipment and gifts for the patients. There is also a helicopter and helipad, plus an assistant robot and a therapy dog.  This building set makes a creative gift for kids and the kit comes with lots of accessories, 5 mini-dolls, 2 baby figures and a toy dog figure.

productName: Hot Dog Food Truck
description: Kids aged 4 and up who love pretend-play food can create lots of different stories with this LEGO® Friends Hot Dog Food Truck (42633) toy. This set helps kids learn to build and it comes with a buildable truck and 2 mini-dolls, plus a cat character and food accessories to inspire role play.  This set makes a great gift idea for kids’ birthdays and other occasions. Budding chefs who love pretend play can help Kaya prepare and serve the hot dogs. Leo is visiting the truck with his cat Churro and enjoys chatting to Kaya about the different food and drink options, which include a vegan hot dog, ketchup, mustard and juices.  LEGO 4+ toy sets are designed to give kids a quick and fun building experience. They come with a helpful Starter Brick – a sturdy base on which kids create the scene. Let the LEGO Builder app guide you and your child on an intuitive building adventure, allowing you to zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Horse and Pony Trailer
description: Kick off hours of creative play with this LEGO® Friends Horse and Pony Trailer (42634) playset toy for girls, boys and kids aged 4 years old and up. Kids who love pretend play can build the car and trailer before creating adventures for friends Liann and Zoya.  This animal-themed creative gift for kids comes with a horse for Liann and a pony for Zoya, plus toy accessories to inspire role-play ideas. Kids can help the characters brush the animals and get them ready for a ride. In the forest they find a fallen tree, which makes an obstacle for the horse and pony to jump over. After a fun day riding, the friends reward the horses with a tasty carrot.  LEGO 4+ toy sets are designed to give kids a fun building experience as they play with building blocks. They come with a Starter Brick – a sturdy base on which kids create the scene. Let the LEGO Builder app guide you and your child on an intuitive building adventure, allowing you to zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track progress.

productName: Kai's Rising Dragon Strike
description: Boys and girls aged 6 and up can recreate adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with Kai’s Rising Dragon Strike (71801) LEGO® building set. Kids will be excited to build the first-ever LEGO NINJAGO dragon action toy before they slam down the dragon’s golden tail and watch as it bursts into action.  This playset comes with 2 minifigures: Rising Dragon Kai, who comes with a katana sword accessory and can ride the buildable dragon action figure, and a Wolf Mask Guard witha crossbow accessory. Kids can stage battles between these LEGO NINJAGO characters to win a blue dragon power element from the dragon action figure toy’s posable mouth.  The rest of the LEGO NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play stories with their heroes (sets sold separately). Each fantasy toy can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Nya's Rising Dragon Strike
description: Boys and girls aged 6 and up can recreate action-packed scenes from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with Nya’s Rising Dragon Strike (71802) ninja playset. Kids will be excited to build the first-ever LEGO® NINJAGO dragon action toybefore they slam down the dragon’s golden tail and watch as it bursts into action.  This building set comes with 2 minifigures: Rising Dragon Nya, who comes with a katana sword accessory and can ride on the dragon model, and a Wolf Mask Claw Warrior wit h claws. Kids can stage epic battles between the ninja figures to win the orange dragon power element from inside the blue dragon’s posable mouth.  The rest of the LEGO NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes (sets sold separately). Each fantasy toy can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Arin's Rising Dragon Strike
description: Boys and girls aged 6 and up can recreate their favorite scenes from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with the Arin’s Rising Dragon Strike (71803) ninja toy. Kids will be excited to build the first-ever LEGO® NINJAGO dragon action toy before they slam down the dragon’s golden tail and watch as it launches into epic battles.  This dragon gift comes with 2 minifigures: Rising Dragon Arin, who has a katana accessory and can ride on the dragon’s back, and a Wolf Mask Warrior with hisown sword accessory. Kids can stage clashes between the ninja figures to win the vibrant green dragon power element from inside the yellow dragon toy’s posable mouth.  The rest of the LEGO NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes (sets sold separately). Each fantasy toy can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Arin's Battle Mech
description: Arin’s Battle Mech (71804) ninja toy lets kids aged 4+ learn to build as they join in with their ninja heroes’ attempt to save their dragon friends. This role-play action toy includes an impressive mech figure to inspire kids to recreate exciting adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show.  This LEGO® set comes with 2 minifigures: Arin with a katana accessory and a Wolf Mask Warrior with a sword accessory. Arin fits in the posable mech figure, which wields a large sword and rotating blade, while the Wolf Mask Warrior can fly in a glider that has posable wings, a disc shooter and 2 spears. There’s also a brick-built crystal cave with a magic mallet inside and a weapons rack with 2 golden katana sword accessories.  This ninja toy has been designed to provide a fun experience for children aged 4+ who are discovering the joy of building with LEGO bricks. The set comes with a Starter Brick: a partly constructed base that gets kids building quickly and with confidence.

productName: Jay's Mech Battle Pack
description: Boys and girls aged 6+ can play out all-action battle scenes from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with this Jay’s Mech Battle Pack (71805) adventure toy. This ninja construction toy for kids features a cool mech figure with posablearms, legs and torso that wields a large golden sword and can fire studs from its 2 shooters.  This ninja toy is packed with 4 NINJAGO minifigures and lots of accessories. Jay is armed with a golden sword and the Master Lloyd minifigure has 2 golden kat ana swords. The Wolf Mask Claw Warrior has a long set of claws on each hand and the Wolf Mask Guard comes with a crossbow.  The rest of the LEGO® NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes dragons, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes. Each adventure toy set can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Off-Road Race Buggy
description: Kids aged 8 and up enjoy big-time fun with this cool vehicle toy. Young builders develop their skills as they assemble the LEGO® Technic™ Off-Road Race Buggy (42164). The experience continues as they test out their model. It features authentic details inspired by real buggy race cars, including rear suspension, a moving 4-cylinder engine and cool flex steering. This set makes a great treat or gift idea for kids who love vehicles and race car toys.  LEGO Technic construction kits combine realistic details with interactive models to inspire young LEGO builders to learn more about engineering. Give kids a fun building adventure with the LEGO Builder app where they can zoom in and rotate models in 3D and track their progress.

productName: Olly and Paisley's Family Houses
description: Creative play is so much fun with this LEGO® Friends Olly and Paisley's Family Houses (42620) toy set for girls, boys and kids aged 7 plus. The dollhouse family set lets kids explore the friendship between neighbors Olly and Paisley and comes with 5 mini-dolls, a micro-doll, 2 pet figures and accessories.  This dollhouse building toy includes Olly and Paisley’s two-story houses plus the tree house that sits between them. In Olly’s house there’s a cozy living area with accessories for serving afternoon tea plus a downstairs bathroom. In Olly’s room there is a bed and food dish for his cat, plus a nightstand and Olly’s collection of fashion drawings.  Paisley’s house has a family kitchen with a dining table, stove, and a fridge with food accessories. Upstairs is the bedroom that Paisley shares with her younger sister. Here’s where she keeps her guitar and photos of her friends. This set makes a creative gift idea for kids who love fun family toys and role play.

productName: 5-Minute Stories
description: LEGO® Batman™ swings to the rescue with LEGO Batman 5-Minute Stories – a 160-page, hardcover picture book containing 9 action-packed stories featuring popular LEGO Batman characters. Each tale takes around 5 minutes to read, making it perfect for bedtime stories and a great way to introduce kids to the joy of reading.

productName: Let's Play Quidditch
description: Begin a bewitching adventure with the LEGO® Harry Potter™ Let’s Play Quidditch™ activity book! Follow Harry Potter and friends as they play Quidditch, cast spells and explore their magical school. An enchanting gift idea for kids, this 32-page book features a story to read, mazes, spot-the-difference puzzles, scenes to color and quizzes, plus a Cedric Diggory LEGO minifigure. It’s hours of spellbinding fun!

productName: GOTHAM CITY's New Defender
description: Kids join LEGO® Batgirl™ to save GOTHAM CITY™ in this fun-filled activity book! With puzzles to solve, mazes to navigate, action scenes to color and much more – including all the pieces kids need to build their own LEGO Batgirl minifigure – this 32-page, softcover book is a super gift for little superheroes.

productName: Jurassic World Dominion: Adventures of a Dino Expert!
description: Young LEGO® Jurassic World Dominion fans can meet all their favorite characters and dinosaur friends in Adventures of a Dino Expert! This 32-page activity book is packed with fun features, comic strips, puzzles and coloring activities and comes with a build-your-own Dr. Alan Grant LEGO minifigure. It makes a fantastic birthday present, holiday gift or anytime surprise for dinosaur-loving kids.

productName: Drill Spinner Vehicle
description: Treat Spidey fans to the LEGO® 4+ Drill Spinner Vehicle (10792) Super Hero toy. With bright colors, familiar characters and fun features, this versatile playset is specially designed to build confidence, improve problem-solving skills and inspire endless imaginative play in kids, boys and girls aged 4+.  This Disney+ Spidey and His Amazing Friends buildable toy contains a push-along Spider-Man car with a rotating front section, a Miles “Spin” Morales minifigure and an Electro minifigure. The set comes with a chassis Starter Brick to help kids get building underway. Intuitive instructions are provided in the form of a colorful picture-story guide.  Designed with budding builders in mind, 4+ sets are packed with engaging details to ensure kids have a great build-and-play experience. Inside the box, each bag contains bricks for a quick-to-build model and character, so play gets started fast. 4+ sets are the perfect way for adults to share building fun with youngsters.

productName: Spidey vs. Green Goblin
description: Treat kids to the LEGO® 4+ Spidey vs. Green Goblin (10793) Super Hero toy vehicle action set. This Marvel Spider-Man toy is specially designed to build confidence, improve problem-solving skills and inspire kids, boys and girls aged 4+ to enjoy endless imaginative play.  This Disney+ Spidey and His Amazing Friends toy vehicle set includes: a Spidey minifigure and his hover spinner with rotating propeller and lift-up cockpit; a Green Goblin minifigure and his glider with pumpkin projectiles; and a Ghost-Spider minifigure with her large, golden web element. There’s also Spidey’s robot friend Trace-E, sea accessories and a cute crab. The set comes with a cockpit Starter Brick to help get building underway and intuitive instructions in the form of a colorful picture-story guide.  Inside the box, each bag contains bricks for a quick-to-build model and character, so play gets started fast. 4+ toys are the perfect way for adults to share building fun with youngsters.

productName: Team Spidey Web Spinner Headquarters
description: Fans of the Disney+ TV series Spidey and His Amazing Friends will know and love the characters, vehicles and other elements in this building toy. This LEGO® 4+ Team Spidey Web Spinner Headquarters (10794) set is specially designed to match the abilities and interests of kids, boys and girls aged 4+.  This LEGO Marvel action hero set includes minifigures of Spidey, Iron Man, Miles “Spin” Morales, Ghost-Spider and Zola. There’s a large mech for Zola with posable legs and claws that can grab a minifigure, and a glide spinner with rotating propellers, openable cockpit and a large, pink web element. The contents of the main building inspire children’s role play by reflecting the Super Heroes’ interests in science, music and painting.  4+ building toys are the perfect way for adults to share fun with youngsters. A large Starter Brick and intuitive instructions in the form of a colorful picture-story guide help to get building underway.

productName: Crafting with Baby Box
description: LEGO® 4+ Gabby’s Dollhouse Crafting with Baby Box (10795) is a pretend-play toy for kids aged 4 and up designed to develop creative skills and inspire imaginative play. This dollhouse playset for children is bursting with bright colors, familiar characters and fun features that fans of DreamWorks Animation’s Gabby’s Dollhouse will know and love.  This LEGO toy for girls and boys is also an arts-and-crafts playset. The pretend-play building set includes a paintbrush, paint, scissors and a spray can, plus a Gabby mini-doll figure and a Baby Box figure. Together, Gabby and Baby Box paint a picture and build a model of Gabby’s dollhouse. There’s even a ladder to help the characters reach the top of the model. The playset has an art-covered wall with cat ears poking out at the top. Packed with engaging details to inspire creative play, the set comes with a Starter Brick to help kids get building underway. Intuitive instructions are provided in the form of a colorful picture-story guide.

productName: Gabby's Kitty Care Ear
description: Gabby’s Kitty Care Ear (10796) is a pet pretend-play and developmental toy for 4+ year old fans of DreamWorks Animation’s Gabby’s Dollhouse. This preschool toy for girls and boys is a great way to build confidence, improve concentration and develop problem-solving skills while having lots of role-play fun!  If you’re looking for a gift for a preschooler who loves caring for animals, this dollhouse playset is the kids’ entertainment toy for you. It includes a Gabby mini-doll and Pandy Paws, BabyKittycorn, Baby Me-Owl and 4 Baby Cupcake figures. The playset comes with a swing, slide, toy train and a 4-seat cupcake-tin stroller. There’s a bath with accessories, including shampoo and a hairbrush. A bottle, cup, storybook and a selection of cozy beds (including a nest for Baby Me-Owl) are included to ensure a relaxing naptime. The set comes with a Starter Brick to help kids get building underway. Intuitive instructions are provided in the form of a colorful picture-story guide.

productName: Gabby's Party Room
description: Gabby’s Party Room (10797) is the ultimate disco playset for fans of DreamWorks Animation’s Gabby’s Dollhouse. This kids’ entertainment toy develops confidence, concentration and problem-solving skills in preschoolers aged 4+.  This toy for girls and boys is a disco party playset and lots more! With Gabby, Daniel James ’DJ’ Catnip, Kitty Fairy and MerCat characters and a variety of music party toys – including a push-along party bus with a built-in keyboard, a rotatable dance floor, guitar, 2 microphones and a sparkling disco ball – the stage is set for endless imaginative play! Accessories include balloons and roller skates for the roller disco, popcorn and 2 glasses full of slush ice for the chill-out zone, and a catapult and cans for the knock-down game. There’s a cake for Gabby and packages with gifts inside delivered down the playset’s slide. The set comes with a large Starter Brick to help kids get building. A colorful picture-story guide provides intuitive instructions.

productName: Creative Pets
description: Animal-lovers aged 5 and up can indulge their passion for pets with this creative animal building set. LEGO® Classic Creative Pets (11034) is an inspirational mix of animal building bricks with simple guides to a colorful range of quick-to-build animal toys. It’s a great way to encourage kids’ creative construction.  With 450 LEGO building bricks, including special pieces with eyes and mouths, and simple step-by-step instructions, kids can build a dog with a bowl and bone, a cat on a stand, a hamster with an apple, a rabbit with a carrot and a bird on a perch. Then, using suggestions included for alternative colors, shapes and functions, kids can rebuild their pets in a fun, new way. As their creative construction skills develop, kids can try out their own ideas. A guide featuring 10 ideas is included to kick-start the free-building fun.  LEGO Classic toys are filled with ideas and inspiration and let parents share building fun and developmental milestones with their kids.

productName: Creative Houses
description: Inspire young builders with LEGO® Classic Creative Houses (11035). With 6 colorful houses for kids to create, combine and customize, this LEGO house building set with windows, doors and accessories boosts creative confidence, improves concentration and develops problem-solving skills in girls and boys aged 4+.  Kids follow simple instructions to build 6 different models in various heights and shapes. The creative fun continues as they add bricks to make houses taller and swap doors, windows, roofs, gardens and more to change each house’s design. There are 8 ideas included to inspire kids to expand their creative construction even further. To scale up the fun, kids can build an extra-large LEGO house using lots of the bricks and pieces from the kit. Instructions can also be found on the LEGO Builder app, which lets kids zoom in, rotate models and track progress.  LEGO Classic toys are filled with ideas and inspiration and let parents share building fun and developmental milestones with their kids.

productName: Creative Vehicles
description: Treat vehicle-loving kids aged 5+ to the LEGO® Classic Creative Vehicles (11036) build-and-play set. This colorful car-building kit contains a mix of building bricks and pieces, plus simple guides to create a colorful set of endlessly rebuildable vehicles.  With 900 construction bricks, special pieces and 52 wheels, plus easy-to-follow instructions, kids can build a police car, ice-cream truck, ATV, front loader, truck, station wagon, off-roader and a limo car toy. Then, using ideas for different designs, cool details and colorful decorations, kids can rebuild their vehicles in fun new ways. As their creative construction skills develop, kids can try out their own designs. Inspiration is included with 10 imaginative ideas to kick-start free-building fun. Instructions are also on the LEGO Builder app, which lets kids zoom in, rotate models and track progress.  LEGO Classic toys are filled with ideas and inspiration and let parents share building fun and developmental milestones with their kids.

productName: Creative Space Planets
description: The LEGO® Classic Creative Space Planets (11037) toy launches young astronauts and stargazers aged 5+ on a journey of creative exploration. The easy-to-build kids’ solar system toy, astronaut and space shuttle model kit is ideal for kids who want to build, play and boldly go where no LEGO builder has gone before!  Kids assemble the colorful bricks to build a rocket ship toy, alien, astronaut and a mini solar system including Mars, Earth, the sun and Saturn with its rings. The space models can then be customized using alternative colors, shapes, eyes, expressions and a stand that allows the model to rotate. There are even glow-in-the-dark bricks for nighttime visibility. The cosmic creativity continues with suggestions for alternative builds, including a complete 8-planet solar system. Guides and digital features are also available on the LEGO Builder app.  LEGO Classic toys are filled with ideas and inspiration and let parents share building fun and developmental milestones with their kids.

productName: Mateo's Off-Road Car
description: Kids aged 7+ can zoom into the awesome LEGO® DREAMZzz™ world with Mateo’s Off-Road Car toy (71471). Based on the exciting TV show, the set lets kids help hero figures Mateo and Z-Blob retrieve a magical hourglass by building the toy vehicle as a dune buggy or a quadcopter. By offering 2 exciting building options, this action toy encourages kids to unlock their imaginations and choose their own adventures. In buggy mode it’s a robust off-road vehicle with turning wheels, and in quadcopter mode it’s a compact flying machine with overpowered rear engines. The set is brought to life by LEGO DREAMZzz characters, including a detailed Mateo minifigure that comes with a shooter. It also features figures of a Grimspawn and Mateo’s gooey sidekick Z-Blob, so kids can get creative and build their own dream adventure.

productName: Izzie's Narwhal Hot-Air Balloon
description: Kids aged 7+ dive into the fantastical LEGO® DREAMZzz™ world with Izzie's Narwhal Hot-Air Balloon toy (71472). Based on the exciting TV show, this building set lets kids help LEGO DREAMZzz hero figure Izzie rescue her animal toy Bunchu the bunny from the grips of a nightmare villain by building a whale figure fantasy toy.This cool LEGO animal toy encourages kids to choose their own adventure and unleash their imaginations by offering them 2 building options. It has lots of features, including an opening mouth and enough space inside to fit small objects such as decorative tiles and balloons. Kids can then transform the deep-sea animal model into a hot-air balloon toy or a fast and agile chariot boat.LEGO DREAMZzz characters, including hero Izzie and a Grimspawn, bring the set to life. It also includes a small figure of Bunchu the bunny, so kids can live out the entire storyline and create their own dream builds.

productName: Mr. Oz's Space Car
description: Kids aged 7+ journey into the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ world with this Mr. Oz’s Space Car toy (71475), which can be built in 2 exciting ways. Based on the thrilling TV show, the building set allows kids to help Mr. Oz and Albert save Jayden, who’s been captured by a Grimspawn.Encouraging kids to choose their own adventure, the space toy can be built in 2 modes – space rover mode or space shuttle mode. In space rover mode, the model has a retractable grabber arm, a moving satellite and a mini rover toy. In space shuttle mode, it has two large shooting cannons and a mini-shuttle toy.DREAMZzz heroes Mr. Oz and Jayden bring the set to life and allow kids to recreate their favorite scenes from the TV show. The building set also includes Albert and a Grimspawn figure, whose tentacles are posable and can trap the Jayden minifigure.

productName: Zoey and Zian the Cat-Owl
description: Unlock imaginations with this LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Zoey and Zian the Cat-Owl (71476) building set. Inspired by the thrilling TV show, this animal toy lets kids aged 9 and up journey into the dream world to help hero figure Zoey save Zian from the villainous Night Hunter.  This set has story-led building instructions and 2 exciting building modes so kids can immerse themselves in the dream world adventure and enjoy double the playtime. Their imaginations will take flight as they build Zian as a Cat-Owl with wings to fly away from the nightmares or as a Cat-Peacock with a beautiful tail to fight them off.  The action is brought to life by 3 minifigures: Zoey, Cooper and the Night Hunter, plus his minions Sneak and Snivel. And with cool accessories like Zoey’s shooting bow and Cooper’s flying motorcycle, this fantasy toy encourages kids to recreate their favorite scenes and dream up new ones for hours of exciting, imaginative play.

productName: The Sandman's Tower
description: Let kids aged 9+ discover The Sandman’s Tower with this LEGO® DREAMZzz™ castle toy (71477). Based on the exciting TV show, this building set allows kids to help hero figures defend the Sandman’s magical home from the evil Never Witch and her minion Sneak! This fantasy toy encourages kids to unleash their imaginations by offering them 2 building options. They can choose to transform it into an imposing fortress or an elegant tower toy. In fortress mode, the model has an hourglass cannon, and in tower mode the model has a spinning top. Both building options include exciting accessories such as a weapons rack, a potion station and a magical book, plus fantasy animal figures, including a posable toy bird and spider toy. Izzie, Mateo, Logan, the Sandman and the villainous Never Witch, plus a figure of Sneak, bring the castle playset to life so kids can build their own dream tower.

productName: The Never Witch's Midnight Raven
description: Let imaginations take flight with this LEGO® DREAMZzz™ The Never Witch’s Midnight Raven (71478) building set for kids aged 9 and up. Inspired by the thrilling TV show, the rebuildable animal toy lets boys and girls create an awesome raven before discovering 2 exciting ways to rebuild it.  Young dreamers will have fun building the villainous Never Witch’s raven before transforming it into a raven-hut or a collection of 3 nightmare creatures: a walking house, a cauldron spider and a giant raven! The house toy has an opening roof and door, the spider toy has a movable cage and legs, and the raven toy has posable wings and feathers.  Mateo, Astrid, the Never Witch, Dizzy and Dogan minifigures, plus a Z-Blob figure, bring the adventure to life. The set also includes story-led building instructions, letting kids immerse themselves in the action and become heroes as they help the dream chasers defeat the Never Witch.

productName: Zoey's Cat Motorcycle
description: Ignite imaginations with the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Zoey’s Cat Motorcycle (71479) bike toy. Inspired by the thrilling TV show, this rebuildable toy cat for kids lets boys and girls aged 7 and up ride into the dream world with a cool LEGO vehicle.  The Never Witch’s raven has stolen a memory and kids need to help Zoey retrieve it! With 2 building options to choose from, young dreamers will love assembling the posable cat figure before transforming it into an awesome catbike with wheels or a speedy toy cat with turbo boosters. The catbike pursues the raven, and the toy cat fights it off.  A fun treat toy to spark creativity, this LEGO DREAMZzz set is brought to life by 2 minifigures, including Zoey, who attaches to the back of the cat model and comes with a shooting bow accessory. It also features story-led building instructions, letting kids become dream world heroes as they live out 2 adventures and enjoy twice the imaginative play with this creative cat-themed toy.

productName: Logan the Mighty Panda
description: Let creativity go wild with the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Logan the Mighty Panda (71480) building set, an awesome rebuildable panda toy for boys and girls aged 7 and up. Inspired by the thrilling TV show, the animal playset lets kids enter the fantastical beast realm.  The Never Witch’s evil raven has stolen a memory from Logan and kids need to help him retrieve it by building a mighty LEGO panda! Young dreamers can build the animal figure, which is posable and wears bamboo armor, before letting their imaginations run free by transforming it into a panda warrior that stands on 2 legs or a panda machine that stands on 4. Both models feature a 6-stud shooter and an opening cockpit.  A panda gift for animal lovers and fans of the LEGO DREAMZzz TV show, this set includes 2 minifigures: hero Logan and his dark doppelganger Dogan. It also includes story-led building instructions, inspiring kids to immerse themselves in the adventure as they enjoy double the play possibilities with this imaginative toy.

productName: Izzie's Dream Animals
description: Hatch imaginations with this LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Izzie’s Dream Animals (71481) set for kids aged 8 and up. Based on the thrilling TV show, this animal playset lets girls and boys discover a magic egg toy that contains rebuildable dream creature figures.  The Never Witch’s raven has stolen a memory from Izzie and creative kids can help her get it back with this fantasy playset. It offers 3 exciting building modes for young dreamers: they can build the egg as a magical red panda toy before rebuildingit as a fantastical bird toy or a sea turtle toy. The red panda can chase down the raven on land, the fantastical bird can pursue the raven in the sky and the mythical turtle can follow the raven underwater.  This LEGO DREAMZzz set is brought to life by 2 minifigures: hero Izzie and evil doppelganger Dizzy, plus a dreamling figure and a mini red panda figure. It also includes story-led building instructions that let kids immerse themselves in the action as they enjoy limitless imaginative play.

productName: The Never Witch's Nightmare Creatures
description: Let imaginations bubble over with the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ The Never Witch’s Nightmare Creatures (71483) magical toys for kids aged 9 and up. Based on the thrilling TV show, this rebuildable fantasy playset lets boys and girls get acquainted with the Never Witch’s evil creatures.  The Never Witch’s raven has swooped in and stolen a memory from Mateo. With her cauldron of nightmares, she uses the memory to create his evil doppelganger MadTeo. But what will she create next? Kids decide! Let young dreamers unleash their creativity and build a raven toy before rebuilding it as a wolf toy or a figure of DoomBlob, Z-Blob’s dark doppelganger.  The magic of this LEGO DREAMZzz set is brought to life by 5 minifigures: Mateo, MadTeo, Doey, Dogan and the Never Witch, who inspire endless role-play possibilities. It also includes story-led building instructions, encouraging kids to immerse themselves in the adventure and bring their wildest dreams to life.

productName: Cooper's Robot Dinosaur C-Rex
description: Let imaginations roar with this LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Cooper’s Robot Dinosaur C-Rex, a rebuildable T. rex dinosaur toy (71484) for kids aged 9 and up. Inspired by the thrilling TV show, it offers boys and girls 2 ways to build an awesome dinosaur model.  Nightmare villains have stolen the Sandman’s tower in a dream jar and Zoey and Cooper need to get it back. Kids can save the day by transforming Cooper’s LEGO junkyard into a T. rex action figure or pterodactyl toy. Sparking hours of imaginative play, both models feature an articulated head, snapping jaws and thrashing tail, as well as twin shooters.  Zoey and Cooper, their dark doppelgangers Doey and Dooper, and a Sneak figure bring the creative toy to life. Zoey comes with a bow accessory and Cooper comes with a hammer accessory, and both heroes can be seated in a car on the dinosaur model’s back. The creative toy also includes story-led instructions, unlocking kids’ imaginations and encouraging them to immerse themselves in the action.

productName: Mateo and Z-Blob the Knight Battle Mech
description: Unlock kids’ imaginations with the LEGO® DREAMZzz™ Mateo and Z-Blob the Knight Battle Mech toy (71485). Inspired by the exciting TV show, this rebuildable playset lets boys and girls aged 10 and up build a LEGO robot in 3 different ways!  Young dreamers will have fun building the Z-Blob space shuttle toy before transforming it into a street knight mech, a street knight centaur or a street battle mech. All models have an opening cockpit, wings and boosters, as well as thrilling accessories including a sword, shield, spear and 2 6-stud shooters. Fueling the excitement, it also features a raven figure and a collectible dream jar.  Brought to life by 4 LEGO DREAMZzz minifigures, the set comes with heroes Mateo and Logan and their dark doppelgangers MadTeo and Dogan, plus figures of evil minions Sneak and Snivel. Sparking imaginative play, the robot toy includes story-led building instructions, encouraging kids to immerse themselves in the adventure and become dream world heroes.

productName: Sora's Elemental Tech Mech
description: Boys and girls aged 7+ can recreate stories from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with the Sora’s Elemental Tech Mech (71807) adventure toy. The cool mech has posable arms and legs that kids can tilt and twist into dramatic battle stances, plus a large sword accessory, a rotating blade and a cockpit to place a ninja minifigure inside.  This never-before-seen customizable mech also lets kids build their very own mech! Its detachable legs, arms and torso can be combined with parts from 2 other mechs: Cole’s Elemental Earth Mech (71806) and Kai’s Elemental Fire Mech (71808) (sold separately). Kids can enjoy hours of fun as they mix and match parts to create a unique action figure toy.  The ninja toy comes with 2 minifigures – Sora with 2 katana sword accessories and a Wolf Mask Claw Warrior – so kids can play out gripping ninja action. The set can also be created with the LEGO® Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Kai's Elemental Fire Mech
description: Kids aged 7+ can recreate stories from season 2 of NINJAGO® Dragons Rising with the Kai’s Elemental Fire Mech (71808) ninja toy. The mech has posable arms and legs that can be tilted and twisted into dramatic battle stances, a cockpit for the ninja minifigure and a big golden sword accessory for role-play battles against the Wolf Mech.  This customizable mech also lets kids build their own mech! Its detachable legs, arms and torso can be combined with parts from 2 other mechs: Cole’s Elemental Earth Mech (71806) and Sora’s Elemental Tech Mech (71807) (sold separately). Kids can enjoy endless fun as they mix and match parts to create a unique action figure toy.  The red mech comes with 4 minifigures – Kai and Zane, both with a katana sword accessory, Jordana with a sword accessory, and a Wolf Mask Warrior – so kids can play out gripping ninja action. The set can also be created with the LEGO® Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building  adventure.

productName: Egalt the Master Dragon
description: Kids aged 8+ can recreate thrilling adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with this large Egalt the Master Dragon (71809) hero toy playset. This is the first-ever Master Dragon toy in the NINJAGO range and features posable legs, tail, head and foil wings, its own sword accessory, and a holder for katana accessories on its back.  This adventure toy comes with 5 minifigures – ninja warriors Lloyd, Sora and Nya, all armed with sword elements, and the villainous duo of Lord Ras with a hammer and Cinder with a sword accessory – so kids can play out ninja battle action. There is also a small brick-built tree containing the magic mallet and gong of shattering accessories, which these NINJAGO characters are battling to win.  LEGO® NINJAGO buildable ninja toys for kids include mechs, vehicles and temples for exciting role-play adventures. Each battle set can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Young Dragon Riyu
description: Boys and girls aged 6+ can recreate aerial adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with this Young Dragon Riyu (71810) playset. This kids’ dragon toy features a Young Riyu model with posable wings and legs, a posable tail, and a saddle so that minifigures can ride on his back.  This ninja toy comes with 3 minifigures: Arin armed with a climbing hook and katana sword accessory, Sora with a katana sword accessory, and a villainous Wolf Mask Warrior with a sword accessory. Kids have all they need to role-play being a ninja warrior and play out action-packed battles.  The LEGO® NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, vehicles and temples for exciting role-play adventures. Each battle set can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Arin's Ninja Off-Road Buggy Car
description: Boys and girls aged 7+ can recreate exciting battles from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with LEGO® NINJAGO Arin’s Ninja Off-Road Buggy Car (71811). This adventure set for kids includes a vehicle toy in Arin’s yellow color featuring moving wheels, suspension, an opening cockpit with space for 2 minifigures, 2 stud shooters with 6 studs to fire and a large hook on the back to help catch villains.  The ninja toy comes with a Baby Riyu model and 4 NINJAGO minifigures: Climber Colewith climbing hook and katana sword accessories, Arin with climbing hook and katana sword accessories, a Wolf Mask Claw Warrior with claws, and Cinder with a sword accessory.  The rest of the LEGO NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, dragons and temples so fans can role-play action with their heroes (sets sold separately). Each ninja playset can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Kai's Ninja Climber Mech
description: Boys and girls aged 9+ can recreate Shadow Forest battles from season 2 of NINJAGO® Dragons Rising with Kai’s Ninja Climber Mech (71812). The adventure set includes a spectacular mech figure in Kai’s red color with 2 big ninja hooks on the back for kids to play out climbing action (or to hang and display it after playtime), posable arms, legs, torso, head and feet, 2 big katana sword accessories and a cockpit for a minifigure.  The ninja toy includes 4 NINJAGO minifigures: Climber Kai and Climber Jay, each with a katana sword accessory, Wyldfyre with 2 flammable fists, and evil Jordana with a glider vehicle.  The rest of the LEGO® NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes dragons, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes (sets sold separately). Each action toy can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Wolf Mask Shadow Dojo
description: Boys and girls aged 9+ can play out thrilling battles from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with the Wolf Mask Shadow Dojo (71813) set. The stunning ninja toy is packed with interactive features and functions to provide kids with countless hours of playtime.  The 2-tiered dojo building kit includes a courtyard where characters can engage in aerial combat on the end of movable transparent sticks, a trap activated by a tree branch, a secret door concealing a sword accessory, a treewith a chain for detaining prisoners, a weapons rack with 4 weapon accessories, wires for the ninja to zip around on using their hooks, a wolf’s head that drops a large stone, the blood moon and the gong of shattering.  The buildable model also comes with 8 NINJAGO character minifigures: Climber Kai, Climber Lloyd, Climber Nya and Climber Zane, all of whom have a climbing hook and katana accessories, villains Lord Ras, Jordana and Cinder, who have sword accessories, and an evil Wolf Mask Claw Warrior.

productName: Kai's Source Dragon Battle
description: The LEGO® NINJAGO® Kai’s Source Dragon Battle (71815) adventure playset helps kids aged 4+ learn how to build while they enjoy exciting ninja adventures in the NINJAGO universe. This action toy features a red dragon model that kids can pose by moving its jaw, head, tail, legs and 4 wings. Kids can also place a fire element in its mouth to scare villains.  This LEGO building toy for kids comes with 4 minifigures: Climber Kai with a katana sword accessory, Wyldfyre with a katana sword accessory, a Wolf Mask Guard with a spear and a Wolf Mask Warrior with a sword accessory. There is also a small forest build to trap characters, a powerful shooter vehicle that can fire a large arrow and 3 small flame elements.  This ninja toy has been specially designed to provide a fun experience for children aged 4+ who are discovering the joys of building with LEGO bricks. The set comes with a Starter Brick that provides a partly constructed base to get kids building quickly and with confidence.

productName: Zane's Ice Motorcycle
description: LEGO® NINJAGO® Zane’s Ice Motorcycle toy (71816) lets boys and girls aged 7+ recreate fast-paced action from season 2 of the NINJAGO Dragons Rising TV show. This ninja toy for kids includes a NINJAGO motorcycle with moving wheels, golden blades and suspension on the back tire. When kids press down on the tire, cool attack-mode ice blades fold out on both sides.This impressive adventure toy comes with a Zane minifigure to ride on the back of the motorbike. Zane is dressed in his never-before-seen tournament armor and holds 2 katana sword accessories for countless hours of role-play action in the NINJAGO world.The LEGO NINJAGO range of sets and buildable action toys includes mechs, dragons and temples so fans can role-play action. Each ninja playset can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure.

productName: Tournament Battle Arena
description: This detailed Tournament Battle Arena (71818) set lets boys and girls aged 7+ recreate the dramatic final showdown from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show. The ninja battle playset includes lots of interactive features to provide kids with hours of playtime. Afterward, it makes an eye-catching display model on a shelf or bedside table.  This LEGO® NINJAGO set includes 2 moving platforms so kids can play out exciting battles with a ninja and a villain, a large drum they can push off its stand to roll into the arena, and a staircase that collapses with the pull of a lever, causing any characters on it to slide to the bottom.  This buildable ninja toy for kids comes with 6 NINJAGO minifigures. Ninja Kai and Sora, in their tournament armor and with never-before-seen short katana sword accessories, battle a collection of villains: Cinder, a Wolf Mask Warrior and, exclusive to this set, Evil Jay and Tox.

productName: Dragon Stone Shrine
description: Boys and girls aged 13 and up can build, play with and display this spectacular LEGO® NINJAGO® Dragon Stone Shrine (71819). This adventure playset is crammed with interactive features and functions that make it perfect for hours of playtime fun oras an impressive model that kids can display on a shelf or bedside table.  The ninja playset includes a stone dragon, a training area that can be moved from side to side as characters do battle, a waterfall, a cherry blossom tree, a library with scrolls , books and a tea set, and a secret room that is revealed when the books in the library are pushed.  This buildable model comes with 6 NINJAGO character minifigures: Master Lloyd with a staff accessory, Master Wu with a spear accessory, Nya with 2 katana sword accessories and a pair of ninja sai, Kai with 2 katana sword accessories and a sword accessory, Euphrasia with a staff accessory and Lord Ras with his hammer. Kids have all they need to play out exciting ninja battles.

productName: Ninja Team Combo Vehicle
description: Boys and girls aged 9+ can enjoy action-packed adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with this Ninja Team Combo Vehicle 4-in-1 adventure toy (71820). Kids can play with the large NINJAGO vehicle action toy before they separate it into 4 smaller vehicles: Sora’s glider with 2 stud shooters, Lloyd’s off-road racer and Cole and Nya’s motorcycles.  This vehicle playset comes with 6 NINJAGO minifigures: ninja Sora, Lloyd, Nya and Cole, dressed in their special tournament armor and armed with katana sword accessories, and their battle rivals, a Wolf Mask Warrior and Wolf Mask General.  The LEGO® NINJAGO range of sets and buildable ninja toys for kids includes dragons, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes. Each ninja playset can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Cole's Titan Dragon Mech
description: Cole’s Titan Dragon Mech (71821) adventure toy lets boys and girls aged 12+ play out action scenes from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show. This is the biggest-ever NINJAGO titan mech and features posable arms, legs, head, body, rotation points and joints so kids can place it into battle stances, a pair of posable dragon wings and a large sword.  This mech toy comes with 1 NINJAGO minifigure: Mech Cole armed with 2 katana sword accessories. There’s also a cockpit beneath the mech’shead so ninja fans can place Mech Cole inside and stride into exciting battles together. Afterward, the Dragon Mech makes a cool display model.  The LEGO® NINJAGO range of buildable ninja toys for kids includes dragons, vehicles and temples so fans can role-play adventures with their heroes. Each action toy set can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Source Dragon of Motion
description: Kids aged 12+ recreate soaring aerial adventures from season 2 of the NINJAGO® Dragons Rising TV show with this awesome Source Dragon of Motion (71822) adventure toy. This is the biggest-ever LEGO® dragon toy, and has posable legs, tail, hips, jaw, head, neck and large wings. It comes with a saddle-throne on its back and 6 smaller spirit dragons.  This dragon toy set includes 6 minifigures for kids to play out battles: ninja warriors Kai, Wyldfyre and Arin (with cool sword and weapon accessories) and the villainous trio of Lord Ras, Jordana and a Wolf Mask Warrior, who each have their own weapon accessories.  The LEGO NINJAGO range of sets and buildable ninja toys for kids includes mechs, vehicles and temples so ninja fans can role-play adventures with their heroes. Each action toy set can be created with the LEGO Builder app, which guides you and your child on an easy and intuitive building adventure. Zoom in and rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress.

productName: Clone Trooper & Battle Droid Battle Pack
description: Inspire youngsters to recreate thrilling Star Wars: The Clone Wars scenes with this LEGO® Star Wars™ Clone Trooper & Battle Droid Battle Pack (75372) for ages 7 and up. It features 4 LEGO Star Wars minifigures and 5 LEGO figures – a Clone Shock Trooper, 3 Clone Troopers, 3 Super Battle Droids and 2 Battle Droids – with iconic weapons for action play. This LEGO building set also includes a stud-shooting Star Wars speeder bike for 2 Clone Troopers and a buildable STAP speeder vehicle toy for a Battle Droid. A tri-droid with 3 flick shooters and a defensive post with a stud shooter add even more creative-play possibilities.  Check out the LEGO Builder app for digital instructions and zoom and rotate viewing tools to enhance children’s building experience.  This buildable playset is great to play with on its own and the characters and builds can be combined with other LEGO Star Wars sets (sold separately) in the extensive range.

productName: Ambush on Mandalore Battle Pack
description: Let kids play out epic jetpack battles with the LEGO® Star Wars: The Mandalorian Ambush on Mandalore Battle Pack (75373). A super anytime fantasy gift idea for creative boys, girls and fans aged 6 and up, this buildable adventure toy playset lets them relive Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season 3 action with 4 collectible LEGO minifigures: a Mandalorian Nite Owl, Mandalorian Warrior and 2 Imperial Commandos.
